subject.why: The subject is clearly a pair of roller skates with pink wheels and pom-poms on the laces as requested.

category.why: The skates float in the air with a slight tilt against a saturated background with radiating light rays.

clean.why: There are no text, UI elements, watermarks, frames, or characters.

framing.why: The skates are centrally framed with adequate margins on all four sides.

colour.why: The bright lime-green background and pink-and-white skates create high contrast and a vibrant, saturated look.

detail.why: The pom-poms feature realistic, fuzzy micro-detail with fine hair fibers instead of clean, simplified geometry.

style.why: The furry pom-poms break the required smooth chunky volume aesthetic shown in the references.

fix: Simplify the pom-poms into smooth, chunky stylized shapes with a satin sheen rather than rendering realistic fuzzy fur fibers.
